title: MAC Address Table Management
description: Manage static and dynamic MAC address table entries.
scenario: Manage static and dynamic MAC address table entries.

objectives.cmd: mac address-table static 00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5E vlan 1 interface FastEthernet0/1

concepts.title: Static MAC Entries
concepts.body: Static MAC entries never age out. Useful for servers or security-critical devices.
concepts.code: SW1(config)# mac address-table static 00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5E vlan 1 interface FastEthernet0/1

concepts.title: Aging Time
concepts.body: Dynamic entries age out after 300 seconds by default. Can be changed globally or per VLAN.

concepts.title: Clearing the Table
concepts.body: "clear mac address-table dynamic" removes all learned entries. Useful after topology changes.
